en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a street scene in a European city. The view looks along intersecting streets lined with multi‑storey brick townhouses and a prominent corner building with mansard roof and decorative window awnings. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalks and stand on the street. Handwritten text frames the image along the top and sides and covers the lower margin. The caption printed beneath the photo reads "Nijmegen."
